failures.description: min_confirmation_frames threshold too high for real footage. archive_001 60s: 1/23 person tracks confirmed. archive_002 120s: 0/41 person tracks confirmed. Starves S06, S07 activity, and narrative completeness.
failures.reproduction: Run pipeline on 60s real clip. Count confirmed vs total person tracks.
failures.root_cause: min_confirmation_frames calibrated for synthetic test data. Real footage has temporal gaps (skip=5), occlusion, and edge-of-frame appearances causing short track durations.
failures.fix: Reduce min_confirmation_frames or use frame-count-relative threshold. Add regression test.

failures.description: TemporalPoseAnalyzer raises AttributeError on all real footage runs. 'object of type TrackBBox has no len()'. All temporal pose events suppressed silently.
failures.reproduction: Run any pipeline on real footage. Check S07 warnings: 'Temporal pose analysis failed'.
failures.root_cause: TemporalPoseAnalyzer calls len() on TrackBBox dataclass expecting a sequence. TrackBBox is a structured object, not iterable by length.
failures.fix: Fix TemporalPoseAnalyzer to use correct TrackBBox attribute access, or provide adapter. Add regression test.
failures.evidence: All 3 runs: S07 warning 'Temporal pose analysis failed: object of type TrackBBox has no len()'

failures.description: 0 COMPLETE story segments in all tested runs (60s, 300s, 120s night). All segments PARTIAL, ENTRY_ONLY, EXIT_ONLY, or MINIMAL.
failures.reproduction: Run pipeline. Check S09 warning: 'No COMPLETE story segments found'.
failures.root_cause: Combination: few confirmed tracks + short clips + COMPLETE requires entry+action+exit for same track. FAIL-006 (low confirmation) directly causes this.
failures.status: OPEN — likely improves if FAIL-006 fixed

failures.description: run_full_pipeline.py funnel builder read em.get('events',[]) but S12 manifest stores events under 'kept_events'. Reported exported_events=0. Actual: 20 (60s), 32 (300s), 19 (archive_002).
failures.root_cause: Measurement script bug — not a pipeline defect. S12 manifest key is 'kept_events', not 'events'.
